request_rules.cursor: opaque string from next_cursor, binds snapshot/view/filter/limit; refresh with cursor is invalid
request_rules.refresh: Initial query builds verified snapshot. Explicit refresh rebuilds it. Search/pagination reuse cached metadata without payload hashing. An import completion should refresh.
request_rules.pack_id: null or import-<64 lowercase hex>; supported for songs and issues views
request_rules.unfiled: songs view only; cannot combine with pack_id

duplicate_rules: exact_content: multiple format-qualified editions with same content identity, or one edition referenced by distinct archive/item paths. evidence_type is multiple_editions, shared_edition, or repeated_source_item. Retry receipts for the same archive/item are counted only in receipt_reference_count and do not create duplicate songs. duplicate.reference_count sums source_reference_count. same_id: distinct editions with exact same score_id. same_title: distinct editions with Unicode lowercase + collapsed whitespace title. Both use evidence_type distinct_editions. Categories may overlap; never auto-merge or claim reclaimable bytes.

issue_row.message: Retained source has no complete receipt

scope: No delete, rename, membership writes, restore or trash endpoint. No browser fallback. Payload verification remains authoritative on existing list/load/export. Snapshot refresh may perform existing verified scan recovery. Retained-only/conflict/ready/error rows never become song memberships.
issue_rules: archive_key is null or validated pack-64hex; song_key is null or validated song-64hex. Receipt references with malformed song keys are unresolved and have null song_key.
